question: Does three-part position information for known word-bigram occurrences add predictive information beyond an identical frozen C2B bag plus original unigram-position logit, bag bigrams, and a shuffled-position control?
selection_disclosure: The pilot was selected after reviewing prior temporal experiments and feature support; it is not outcome-blind. E67 and E75 query windows overlap.

feature_contract.tokenization: Frozen TfidfVectorizer preprocessor/tokenizer: Unicode strip accents, lowercase, token_pattern (?u)\b\w\w+\b.
feature_contract.pairs: All adjacent normalized token pairs; OOV pairs remain in the pair sequence and define segment boundaries.
feature_contract.position_bins: For pair occurrence j among m pairs, bin=floor(3*j/m), zero-based.
feature_contract.known_terms: Exact bigram phrase lookup in the origin's frozen prefix C2B vocabulary; original IDF is reused.
feature_contract.tf_idf: (1+log(count))*IDF for each known term/bin, followed by a single whole-row L2 normalization.
feature_contract.shuffle: Seed-42 deterministic permutation of pair occurrences within each document, preserving pair multiset, bag counts, and all three bin sizes.

arms.BAG: All known bigram counts with original IDF, sublinear TF, and row L2 norm.
arms.REAL: Known bigrams assigned to observed first/middle/final thirds.
arms.SHUFFLED: Same pair occurrences assigned after within-document pair-sequence shuffle.

model.frozen_offset: z_original = C2B bag intercept + C2B bag matrix @ saved coefficients + original unigram-position matrix @ its saved gamma; direct float64 computation.
model.learned_parameters: One new gamma vector per origin and arm; initialized at zero; no new intercept.
model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize, L-BFGS-B, jac=True, maxiter=2000, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-6, maxls=50.
model.acceptance: Optimizer success, finite gamma/loss/gradient, final objective <= zero-gamma objective + 1e-8; single attempt, no retries.

prediction_policy.no_known_bigram: Exact frozen MIX50 probability on present rows; additionally verify zero-gamma equivalence <=1e-12.
prediction_policy.comparator: Frozen MIX50; all three new arms retain identical structured/text source boundaries.

fit_defined_subgroups.unsupported: Report UNKNOWN; do not silently drop from report or claim overall qualification.

qualification_gates.interpretation: Engineering screening criteria, not significance tests or evidence of causality.

source_boundaries.preflight: Official Train identity and signal_stream only; frozen matrices, gamma, probabilities, and named non-target arrays.
source_boundaries.fit_labels: Only the exact row indices in the frozen origin prefix are parsed after that fit's durable FIT_STARTED event.
source_boundaries.query_labels: Remain closed until all six gamma receipts/predictions pass the independent prelabel verifier.

limitations: E67 and E75 are nested development views, not independent replication or untouched holdout.
BAG has fewer columns than REAL/SHUFFLED; REAL-versus-SHUFFLED is the matched-capacity position contrast.
Sequential additive fitting uses saved in-sample base logits; it is not cross-fitted residual training.
No causal, semantic, quality, or Test-generalization claim is authorized.
